reasons.text: The preference tier Series B Preferred is fully paid ($9,499,997.97). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the next tier's preference (Series A Preferred).
The preference tier Series A Preferred is fully paid ($3,500,000.00). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the next tier's preference (Seed Preferred).
The preference tier Seed Preferred is fully paid ($3,312,499.20). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the residual, shared as common.

Common reaches $0.10 per share, the strike on the 200,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Common reaches $0.25 per share, the strike on the 700,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Seed Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (3,312,499.20 common shares at $1.0000 each = $3,312,499.20) equals its 1x preference of $3,312,499.20. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Series A Preferred reaches its cap: preference plus participation totals 2.5x its original issue price ($8,750,000.00). Above this exit value its payout stays flat until converting to common pays more.

Series B Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (5,004,100 common shares at $1.8984 each = $9,499,997.97) equals its 1x preference of $9,499,997.97. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Series A Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (3,500,000 common shares at $2.5000 each = $8,750,000.00) equals its capped payout of $8,750,000.00 (2.5x its original issue price). Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.
